next_gate.required_identity: same process creation identity, module path/base/size, exact pinned file SHA and stable mapping
next_gate.read_policy: one bounded read only if committed/readable and mapping matches module; stop on guard/noaccess/identity change; do not change protection or attach debugger
next_gate.resolution_policy: compare captured pointer with exact export addresses of matching loaded Windows modules; retain all aliases; unresolved/hooked/non-export addresses stay unresolved; do not chase trampolines
next_gate.success_criterion: Unique supported export match confirms current binding, not page-preparation semantics. Standard API binding would deprioritize this branch as a direct decryptor search.
